invalid stored values and writes valid selections as a non-expiring raw localStorage value.","With no saved preference, the rendered join, loading, error, and meeting interface initially uses the existing dark theme.","A sun/moon icon button with a descriptive accessible label and title tooltip is in the top-right header on both join and meeting screens.","Settings is renamed from Device Settings, includes an Appearance section near its top, and its selector and both header toggles immediately show and apply the same selected theme.","The selected light or dark theme remains active after restarting the renderer until the user changes it or clears renderer app data.","Light mode uses white and light-slate interface surfaces with AA-readable text, controls, status states, borders, and visible keyboard focus across join, meeting sidebar, Settings, loading, error, transcript, summary, and STT-status states while retaining blue-violet accents.","Video tiles, camera preview, and media overlays including their floating controls remain dark when light mode is selected.","Theme changes use a brief color-only transition that is suppressed or reduced for prefers-reduced-motion values.","files":["frontend/src/utils/themePreference.js","frontend/test/themePreference.test.js"],"testSupportFiles":[],"dependencies":[],"verification":["Run `npm --prefix frontend test -- Add Tailwind v4 light variant, dark-default/light root tokens, color-only theme transition rules, reduced-motion overrides, and robust global keyboard-focus rules in the imported stylesheet.
